description: Use to read one HyLogger-scanned hole by its key (from find_core_scans). Returns where and what it is, the scanned depth range, logged geology per metre (summarised to up to 15 rock types and their metres), the spectral datasets and which were kept, the data-quality issues found and their depths, the core-type model's summary, sample intervals, and links to its CoreFlagging page, line-scan image and sample sheets.
name: get_core_scan_hole
title: Get a scanned drillhole
